ns2:course.label: History of Historiography
ns2:course.description: An exploration of the different approaches to the conceptualization and narration of history in various times and places, with special emphasis on the social, cultural, and political role(s) of the historian. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
